hero.summary_en: A bounded automatic Ontario route now publishes AGCO-approved Woodbine Mohawk Park meeting dates at rank C; complete Canadian provincial and multi-code coverage remains unresolved.
hero.summary_ja: オンタリオの限定自動ルートとして、AGCO承認Woodbine Mohawk Park開催日をCで公開する。カナダ全体の州別・複数体系網羅は未完了。

paragraphs_en: The active production route is limited to Woodbine Mohawk Park within the reviewed Ontario Racing context.
Standardbred Canada remains a separate reviewed prototype and does not make this route countrywide.
paragraphs_ja: 稼働中productionルートは確認済みOntario Racing文脈のWoodbine Mohawk Parkに限定する。
Standardbred Canadaは別の確認済みprototypeとして残し、このルートを全国網羅とは扱わない。

calendar_guidance_en: Automatically publish only AGCO-approved Woodbine Mohawk Park dates from the reviewed 2026 calendar at rank C. Keep other Canadian provinces, codes and venues outside this production claim until separately reviewed.
